title: Cross-platform code retrieval and classifier triage
request:
Improve code reading and retrieval for Windows and Unix-based systems. Explore tools we can use with the mod (e.g. ripgrep for Unix and Windows alternatives) and check whether the classifier triages relevant files or scripts to use.

The agreed plan: bh plan show p-20261121-0b9c

steps.title: Record before baselines with `node test/bench/baseline.mjs` and add a pinned binary manifest (`mods/bot-herdr/engine/tools-manifest.json`) plus install-time fetcher in `install.mjs` that downloads and SHA256-verifies `rg` (`BurntSushi/ripgrep` 15.2.0), `fd` (`sharkdp/fd` v10.5.2), and `ast-grep` (`ast-grep/ast-grep` 0.51.3) for the current OS/arch (Windows x64/arm64, Linux x64/arm64, macOS x64/arm64) into a cached `appHome` bin folder copied to `mods/bot-herdr/engine/bin/`, degrading cleanly when offline without failing `install.mjs`.

report.summary: Install-time rg/fd/ast-grep provisioning, batched scripts+layout triage, role prompts, tests: 366 pass, bh check PASS (dev-wave2)

steps.title: Build a shared cross-platform retrieval layer in `mods/bot-herdr/engine/scripts/lib/common.mjs`: resolve bundled `engine/bin/<tool>` first, then PATH, then `git grep --untracked` / `git ls-files`, then pure Node.js; normalize Windows/Unix paths to `/`-relative repo paths, strip CRLF, exclude `.bot-herdr/` noise by default, enforce `-e` and `--` argument guards with no `shell: true`, pass `-c core.quotepath=false` to git, and fail loudly on backend errors instead of printing "not found".

report.summary: Retrieval layer, new scripts and Windows fixes: npm test 352 pass/0 fail, bh check PASS

steps.title: Upgrade existing reading scripts (`find_symbol.mjs`, `repo_map.mjs`, `outline_file.mjs`, `find_tests_for.mjs`, `find_test_fixtures.mjs`, and `bh knowledge ask` in `bh.mjs`) to use the shared retrieval layer so they find untracked files, work in non-git folders, exclude `.bot-herdr/` noise by default, and handle Windows paths and CRLF cleanly.

Add the new retrieval scripts: token-budgeted `search_code.mjs` (literal/regex search with globs, context lines, and hard output caps), `find_symbol.mjs --body` (returning full declarations via `declarations()`), multi-range `read_slice.mjs`, `find_files.mjs` (`fd` → `rg --files` → `git ls-files` → Node), `ast_search.mjs` (wrapping `ast-grep` with normalized `/`-relative output, caps, and clean unavailable guidance), and deterministic `locate.mjs` (combining symbol/keyword matches + `importGraph` + `testsFor` into a ranked file shortlist).

Wire classifier script triage and layout context: pass `repo_map` layout into `triageAndSkills` on `bh task new` (`bh.mjs:362`), batch `pickScripts` with `scoreEffort` in one classifier call on `bh spawn` (zero extra round-trips), fix harness/Clef multi-pick collapse (`classifier/harness.mjs:75`), validate every pick against real candidates, inject matched script names and usage lines into child briefs, and fall back to `keywordPick` when the classifier is off or fails.

Fix all sibling Windows breakages across engine scripts: replace Unix-only `cat` in `check_changed.mjs` with `readFileSync`, add cross-platform shell execution for `failure_digest.mjs --run` and Windows drive-letter/`file://`/backslash parsing, resolve `.cmd` shims for `npx` and `python`/`py` fallback in `check_changed.mjs`, `run_changed_tests.mjs`, and `common.mjs`, fix `\` vs `/` path comparisons in `check_contract_breakage.mjs` and `affected_packages.mjs`, stop mutating `RUNNERS[".py"]` in `lib/scripts.mjs`, and add `-e` guards to all remaining `git grep` callers.

Update role prompts (`mods/bot-herdr/engine/roles/{global,scout,worker,orchestrator}.md`) to teach the cross-platform `bh` retrieval commands (`repo_map`, `locate`, `search_code`, `find_symbol --body`, `outline_file`, `read_slice`, `find_files`, `ast_search`) and remove Unix-only `grep`/`find` wording.

Add injectable cross-platform unit and integration tests covering install-time binary provisioning/checksums/offline fallback, resolution order (`engine/bin` → PATH → `git` → Node), backend parity on Windows/Unix paths, drive letters, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, spaces, and non-ASCII filenames, `-e`/argument-injection/path-traversal guards, sibling Windows script fixes, and batched `pickScripts` + fallbacks; re-run `node test/bench/baseline.mjs` to record before/after metrics.
